notes.title: Quality of life changes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I just released a quality of life update with all the features you guys and gals requested!

- [b]Added the possibiilty to resize the game window in windowed mode (press alt-enter to switch between modes).
- [b]The game will now auto-pause if the the game window loses focus during the enemies turn.[/b]
- [b]Hovering a goodie (mushrooms, weapons, artifacts) in the status screen will now tell you at which level it unlocks[/b].

As always, if you find some more bug to squash or have suggestions feel free to write here in the community hub or at info@wackyspores.com and I'll fix everything ASAP!

GLHF!
Lorenzo

notes.title: First patch!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

I just uploaded a small patch to fix the "I choose whatever characters I want, I don't care if they're locked" bug found by KevGuuey (thanks for the heads up man!) in his video. 
More specifically:

- [b]Fixed being able to select locked characters under certain conditions[/b]. 
If you saved the game with an "illegal" mushroom in the party: patch the game, go to the status screen (mushroom button in the worldmap), deselect the mushroom(s) that should not be in your party (the locked ones) and select three of the unlocked ones.

- [b]Fixed being able to go to the main menu while in a dialogue[/b].

If you find some more bug to squash or have suggestions feel free to write here in the community hub or at info@wackyspores.com and I'll fix everything ASAP!

Have fun!
Lorenzo
